title: FeatureList
description: Per-plan feature tracking file (BEHAV-05). One file per PLAN.md stored alongside it in .planning/phases/XX-name/. Filename: {plan_id}-feature_list.json. Validator overwrites this file after each test run — it is the current state snapshot, not a history log.

generated_at.description: ISO8601 UTC when the file was first generated (by planner at plan-write time).

last_updated.description: ISO8601 UTC of last featureListUpdate() run. Null on initial generation.

features.description: One entry per task in the plan.

task_id.description: The task XML id attribute this feature corresponds to.

description.description: First acceptance criteria bullet (truncated at 200 chars for token budget).

status.description: pending: not yet verified. passing: last test run succeeded. failing: last test run failed. Blocks --pass verdict when any feature is 'failing'.

test_file.description: Path to the test file that verifies this feature. Null if no test file declared in files_expected.

last_verified.description: ISO8601 UTC of the last verification run. Null if never run.
